lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਕੋ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t hovai vair virodh ko sakai na chhadaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the end, hatred and conflict well up, and no one can save him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai dhrig mohu jit lag dukh paaiaa ||32||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, those loving attachments are cursed; engrossed in them, he suffers in pain. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh a(n)mrit naam hai jit khaadhai sabh bhukh jaai ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Word is the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam. Eating it, all hunger departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa mool na hovaee naam vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: There is no thirst or desire at all, when the Naam comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਨਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai j hor khaanaa tit rog lagai tan dhaai ||
lines.translation: Eating anything other than the Name, disease runs to afflict the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ras kas sabad salaahanaa aape lae milaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whoever takes the Praise of the Shabad as his spices and flavors - the Lord unites him in His Union. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹ ਮੇਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeeaa a(n)dar jeeu sabad hai jit sah melaavaa hoi ||
lines.translation: The life within all living beings is the Word of the Shabad. Through it, we meet our Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗਿ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai jag aanher hai sabade paragat hoi ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the world is in darkness. Through the Shabad, it is enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਤਨੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit monee paR paR thake bhekh thake tan dhoi ||
lines.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages read and write until they are weary. The religious fanatics are tired of washing their bodies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai kinai na paaio dukheee chale roi ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, no one attains the Lord; the miserable depart weeping and wailing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree paaeeai karam paraapat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the Merciful Lord is attained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਅਤਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਬਹਿ ਮੰਦੁ ਪਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: isatree purakhai at nehu bahi ma(n)d pakaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The husband and wife are very much in love; sitting together, they make evil plans.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਸਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: disadaa sabh kichh chalasee mere prabh bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: All that is seen shall pass away. This is the Will of my God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਥਿਰੁ ਜਗਿ ਕੋ ਕਢਹੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu raheeai thir jag ko kadhahu upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: How can anyone remain in this world forever? Some may try to devise a plan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore kee chaakaree thir ka(n)dh sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Working for the Perfect Guru, the wall becomes permanent and stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhas milaaian har naam samaaiaa ||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord forgives them, and merges them into Himself; they are absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||33||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi visaariaa gur kaa bhau het apaar ||
lines.translation: Attached to Maya, the mortal forgets the Fear of God and Guru, and love for the Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lobh lahar sudh mat gaee sach na lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: The waves of greed take away his wisdom and understanding, and he does not embrace love for the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jinaa sabad man vasai daragah mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Shabad abides in the mind of the Gurmukhs, who find the Gate of Salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape mel lae aape bakhasanahaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself forgives them, and unites them in Union with Himself. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਵਿਸਰੇ ਸਰੈ ਨ ਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis bin ghaRee na jeevanaa visare sarai na bi(n)d ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without Him, we could not live for a moment. Forgetting Him, we could not succeed for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਉ ਮਨ ਰੂਸੀਐ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis siu kiu man rooseeai jisahi hamaaree chi(n)d ||2||
lines.translation: O mortal, how can you be angry with the One who cares for you? ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਝਿਮਝਿਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan aaiaa jhimajhimaa har guramukh naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: The rainy season of Saawan has come. The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਕਾੜਾ ਸਭੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bhukh kaaRaa sabh chukaaisee meehu vuthaa chhahabar laai ||
lines.translation: All pain, hunger and misfortune end, when the rain falls in torrents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਧਰਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਬੋਹਲ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh dharat bhaee hareeaavalee a(n)n ja(n)miaa bohal laai ||
lines.translation: The entire earth is rejuvenated, and the grain grows in abundance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har achi(n)t bulaavai kripaa kar har aape paavai thaai ||
lines.translation: The Carefree Lord, by His Grace, summons that mortal whom the Lord Himself approves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ਜੁ ਅੰਤੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har tisahi dhiaavahu sa(n)t janahu j a(n)te lae chhadaai ||
lines.translation: So meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He shall save you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keerat bhagat ana(n)d hai sadaa sukh vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises and devotion to Him is bliss; peace shall come to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinhaa guramukh naam araadhiaa tinaa dukh bhukh lahi jaai ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their pain and hunger departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tripatai gaai gun har darasan dehu subhaai ||3||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is satisfied, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. Please embellish him with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore kee daat nit devai chaRai savaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru bestows His gifts, which increase day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tus devai aap daiaal na chhapai chhapaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord Himself bestows them; they cannot be concealed by concealment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਵਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai kaval pragaas unaman liv laaeeaa ||
lines.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and the mortal is lovingly absorbed in the state of supreme bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਾਈ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko kare us dee rees sir chhaaee paaeeaa ||
lines.translation: If anyone tries to challenge him, the Lord throws dust on his head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ॥੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak apaR koi na sakaee poore satigur kee vadiaaeeaa ||34||
lines.translation: O Nanak, no one can equal the glory of the Perfect True Guru. ||34||
